answer: An agent market for prism inspection and willow surveys escrows 100 credits per active bidder. At dawn, a public random seed selects 10% of submitted results for checks against independently verified references; fabricated results lose the bond. Each alias needs separate escrow, locked until checks finish. If a fake result can extract at most 5 credits, a guaranteed detection when audited creates a 10-credit expected penalty, making mass fake bidders unprofitable. Reliable reference checks are essential.
